title: Tests: group chat creation and multi-peer delivery (3-instance harness)
description:
What: Integration test for group chat: 3-instance harness, message sent by one member arrives at all other members.

Algorithm:
1. Extend the two-instance harness to support 3 instances (A, B, C).
2. A creates group chat with participantIds = [a_id, b_id, c_id].
3. Verify chatId matches Python oracle: sha256(sorted([a_id, b_id, c_id]).join(\x00)).
4. A sends message in group chat (Message/set create).
5. Outbox delivers to B and C.
6. B calls Message/get — verifies message exists with correct chatId and body.
7. C calls Message/get — same verification.
8. B sends reply in same group chat.
9. A and C receive the reply.
10. Verify Peer/deliver at A and C accepts B's group message (chatId recomputed at receiver).

Oracle: chatId computed by Python hashlib.sha256 with sorted participants joined by \x00 — hardcoded hex literal in test.

Agent team: R reads existing two-instance harness; T extends to 3-instance and writes group chat scenario; V runs cargo test -p kithd --features test-utils + clippy.
